reference_status: Awaiting verify02 and independent uncertainty review; no training authorized by this config yet.
head_input_scaling: Coefficient PCA on the frozen learned-bank training outputs initializes the common affine head; standardized scores are dimensionless, so latent input scales are one. This does not replace the trained neural spatial bank with POD.
fit_starts: six equally spaced rows of the trained training-code table
fit_doubled_budget: 800 iterations from the exact same eight initial starts as the 400-iteration run; select the best finite result uniformly.
accuracy_rule: At primary dt every validation rollout completes, has max normalized displacement/velocity/energy-state error <=0.10, selected fits stationary, and Jacobians full rank. Other steps reported separately.
pod_algorithm: Fresh randomized SVD, rank64+24 oversampling, four power iterations, normalized training displacement+velocity only.
